name: send-latency
task: Send one keystroke, time until the sender's own hook callback fires
ahk: ahk/send-latency.ahk (letter probe key into own off-screen Edit)
caveats: AHK OnKeyDown fires only for KeyOpt-N-registered keys; F13-F24 and Shift never arrive (probed). Probe key differs by side (F24 vs letter) by necessity.
Off-screen windows do not receive chars in any Send mode (probed); AHK integrity is hook receipt + foreground-held, not Edit text.
Rime pairs by down-event order; AHK pairs send-stamp to callback-stamp by index; negatives counted as reordered.
